lines.zh: 整群一起转，浪也跟着弯。
lines.en: The whole school turns, and the wave bends with us.

lines.zh: 逆流游三下，再顺流漂一段。
lines.en: Three strokes against the current, then drift a while.

lines.zh: 银色的肚皮，是给同伴看的。
lines.en: My silver belly is a signal for my schoolmates.

lines.zh: 贴着礁石走，水流省力。
lines.en: Hug the reef line; the current does the work.

lines.zh: 前面那条转弯了，我也转。
lines.en: The one ahead turned, so I turn too.

lines.zh: 别掉队，掉队就显眼。
lines.en: Do not fall behind; falling behind makes you visible.

lines.zh: 海面有光，往那边靠一点。
lines.en: There is light at the surface; drift a little toward it.

lines.zh: 几千条一起摆尾，水都响了。
lines.en: Thousands of tails beating at once make the water loud.

lines.zh: 绕过海草，别缠住鳍。
lines.en: Swim around the kelp so it cannot snag a fin.

lines.zh: 往下潜一点，浪小。
lines.en: Dive a little deeper where the waves are smaller.

lines.zh: 水比昨天冷，鱼群游得慢。
lines.en: The water is colder than yesterday, and the school swims slower.

lines.zh: 队伍的缝隙只有半个身子宽。
lines.en: The gap in the school is only half a body wide.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，能窜出很远。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me quite far.

lines.zh: 沙底的水浑，换个方向。
lines.en: The water is murky over the sand; change direction.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面那条的尾鳍摆。
lines.en: I match the tailbeat of the one ahead.

lines.zh: 水变咸了，说明快到海口。
lines.en: The water turned saltier; the estuary is near.

lines.zh: 我从船影下面穿过去，那里凉。
lines.en: I pass under a boat's shadow, where it is cool.

lines.zh: 整群一起侧身，像一块银板。
lines.en: The whole school turns at once like a silver plate.

lines.zh: 停在水里，鳍还在轻轻划。
lines.en: Hovering in place, my fins still paddle softly.

lines.zh: 张开嘴，滤一点浮游的东西。
lines.en: Mouth open, filtering whatever drifts in.

lines.zh: 鳞片反光，像一小片碎镜子。
lines.en: My scales flash like a scrap of broken mirror.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，数着水的味道。
lines.en: Gills opening and closing, tasting the water.

lines.zh: 同伴都静下来，我也静下来。
lines.en: The school went still, so I go still too.

lines.zh: 水草影子晃，不是敌人。
lines.en: That swaying shadow is only kelp, not an enemy.

lines.zh: 侧着身子，让水流过鳃。
lines.en: Turning sideways to let the current pass my gills.

lines.zh: 肚子有点空，等浮游群过来。
lines.en: My belly is a bit empty; I wait for the plankton drift.

lines.zh: 海面的光斑在背上一块块移。
lines.en: Patches of surface light slide across my back.

lines.zh: 这样悬着，比游着省力。
lines.en: Hovering like this costs less than swimming.

lines.zh: 听到远处的船声，压低了。
lines.en: Hearing a distant boat, I sink lower.

lines.zh: 鳍尖碰到同伴，算是打了招呼。
lines.en: My fin tip brushed a schoolmate, which counts as greeting.

lines.zh: 海流换了方向，我跟着偏。
lines.en: The current shifted, so I angle along with it.

lines.zh: 水太清了，反而有点不安。
lines.en: The water is so clear it makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，为什么一直看我？
lines.en: You are on the shore; why do you keep watching me?

lines.zh: 放大看，我的眼睛在两侧。
lines.en: Look closely: my eyes sit on either side.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶，我认识。
lines.en: That bucket in your hand is familiar to me.

lines.zh: 影子投进水里，鱼群散了。
lines.en: Your shadow hits the water and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 别敲水面，声音传得很远。
lines.en: Do not tap the surface; sound carries far down here.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，是想看清你。
lines.en: I turn sideways to get a better look at you.

lines.zh: 你在数我们有多少条吗？
lines.en: Are you trying to count how many of us there are?

lines.zh: 银色一片，你分不清哪条是我。
lines.en: A sheet of silver; you cannot tell which one is me.

lines.zh: 你蹲久了，膝盖会疼的。
lines.en: Crouch there too long and your knees will ache.

lines.zh: 水里听不清你说什么，只听到震动。
lines.en: I cannot hear your words, only the vibration.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，海水刺得疼。
lines.en: A scale came off, and the salt water stings.

lines.zh: 被撞得翻了身，好不容易正过来。
lines.en: Knocked onto my side, I barely righted myself.

lines.zh: 鳃动得很急，我有点慌。
lines.en: My gills are pumping fast; I am panicking.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里，藏不住味道。
lines.en: A wound in water cannot hide its smell.

lines.zh: 疼得往深处沉，那里安全。
lines.en: The pain makes me sink deeper, where it is safer.

lines.zh: 队伍把我挤在中间，稍微好受些。
lines.en: The school pressed around me, which helps a little.

lines.zh: 尾巴少了一角，游起来偏。
lines.en: A corner of my tail is gone, so I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉出了队伍。
lines.en: That blow knocked me out of the formation.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，得快走。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water; I must move fast.

lines.zh: 忍着，游到礁石后面再说。
lines.en: Endure it and swim behind the reef first.

lines.zh: 有细小的东西在漂，我过去看看。
lines.en: Something tiny is drifting; I will go take a look.

lines.zh: 那点碎屑，够我吃一口。
lines.en: That crumb is enough for one mouthful.

lines.zh: 别撒太多，水会浑。
lines.en: Do not scatter too much; the water will cloud.

lines.zh: 同伴都冲过去了，我也去。
lines.en: The school rushed over, so I go too.

lines.zh: 闪光的不是食物，但我还是想看。
lines.en: The shiny thing is not food, but I still want to look.

lines.zh: 张开嘴，跟着碎屑走。
lines.en: Mouth open, I follow the drifting crumbs.

lines.zh: 这一口太小，得再来几口。
lines.en: That mouthful was tiny; I need several more.

lines.zh: 抢食的时候，队形全乱了。
lines.en: When we feed, the formation falls apart completely.

lines.zh: 闻到腥味，是从你手上来的。
lines.en: That fishy smell is coming from your hands.

lines.zh: 吃到嘴里才发现是沙。
lines.en: Only after swallowing did I realize it was sand.

lines.zh: 撞到同伴了，队伍挤成一团。
lines.en: Bumped a schoolmate, and the school bunched up.

lines.zh: 水下看不清，转身就撞上。
lines.en: I cannot see well down here and turned into someone.

lines.zh: 鳞片被蹭掉一片，有点疼。
lines.en: A scale scraped off; it stings a little.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进浅水，撞散了我们。
lines.en: Your boot stepped into the shallows and split the school.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要回队伍里。
lines.en: Make room; I need to get back into formation.

lines.zh: 撞上礁石，头上起了包。
lines.en: Hit the reef and raised a bump on my head.

lines.zh: 水流把我推过去，不是故意的。
lines.en: The current pushed me into you; it was not intentional.

lines.zh: 鱼群一挤，我差点翻过去。
lines.en: The school squeezed and I nearly flipped over.

lines.zh: 鳍碰到鳍，各让半寸。
lines.en: Fin against fin, we each give half an inch.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，我吓得往下沉。
lines.en: The splash startled me, so I sank downward.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，几百条挤不过去。
lines.en: This gap is too narrow for hundreds of us.

lines.zh: 撞完先游两圈，看看有没有伤。
lines.en: After the collision I swim two laps to check for damage.

lines.zh: 产卵要去浅水，那里暖和。
lines.en: Spawning happens in the shallows, where it is warmer.

lines.zh: 跟着你游，尾鳍别乱摆。
lines.en: Swim beside me and keep your tail steady.

lines.zh: 水草上那一小团，是我们的。
lines.en: That small cluster on the weed belongs to us.

lines.zh: 成千上万颗卵，总会活下一些。
lines.en: Thousands of eggs, and some will surely survive.

lines.zh: 这时候队伍最松，正好成对。
lines.en: This is when the school loosens, perfect for pairing.

lines.zh: 你银色的侧面，我看得最清。
lines.en: Your silver flank is the clearest thing I see.

lines.zh: 潮水涨起来，就往浅处去。
lines.en: When the tide rises, we head for the shallows.

lines.zh: 护着卵，别让蟹靠近。
lines.en: Guard the eggs; do not let the crabs get close.

lines.zh: 游慢一点，等我一起。
lines.en: Swim a little slower and wait for me.

lines.zh: 明年这个时候，还在这片海。
lines.en: This time next year, we will still be in this sea.

lines.zh: 桶里水够吗？我不想搁浅。
lines.en: Is there enough water in the bucket? I do not want to beach.

lines.zh: 被捞起来，世界突然变窄。
lines.en: Scooped up, my whole world suddenly narrowed.

lines.zh: 桶壁很滑，我贴着转圈。
lines.en: The bucket wall is slick; I circle against it.

lines.zh: 放我回海里，我认得出这片礁。
lines.en: Put me back in the sea; I know this reef.

lines.zh: 水一晃，我的鳞片全在响。
lines.en: The water sloshes and all my scales rattle.

lines.zh: 别把桶提太高，水会洒。
lines.en: Do not lift the bucket too high; the water spills.

lines.zh: 盖住口，我跳得出去。
lines.en: Cover the top, or I will jump out.

lines.zh: 在桶里也能感到潮水的方向。
lines.en: Even in the bucket I can feel which way the tide runs.

lines.zh: 我侧躺着，鳃还在动。
lines.en: I lie on my side, gills still moving.

lines.zh: 到了新地方，先闻水。
lines.en: In a new place, I taste the water first.

lines.zh: 有大的影子压下来，全群散开。
lines.en: A big shadow descended, and the whole school burst apart.

lines.zh: 左边有动静，我先沉半米。
lines.en: Something moved on the left; I sink half a meter.

lines.zh: 那条鱼比我们长，不像同类。
lines.en: That fish is longer than us and not one of us.

lines.zh: 同伴尾巴一抖，我也跟着警醒。
lines.en: A schoolmate's tail flicked, and I snap alert.

lines.zh: 水压变了，有东西在靠近。
lines.en: The pressure changed; something is approaching.

lines.zh: 先缩紧队形，再决定往哪逃。
lines.en: Tighten the formation first, then choose an escape.

lines.zh: 那只海鸟的影子落在水上。
lines.en: That seabird's shadow has fallen on the water.

lines.zh: 把鳃闭上，别发出声音。
lines.en: Close the gills and make no sound.

lines.zh: 它盯着队尾那条，不是盯着我。
lines.en: It is watching the one at the tail, not me.

lines.zh: 潮沟那边水深，能躲。
lines.en: The water is deeper in the tidal channel; we can hide.

lines.zh: 整群往一个方向转，才不乱。
lines.en: The whole school must turn one way to stay orderly.

lines.zh: 贴着底下的沙，避开上面的影子。
lines.en: Stay near the sand to avoid the shadow above.

lines.zh: 一半向左，一半向右，先分开。
lines.en: Half left, half right; split apart first.

lines.zh: 盯着最近的礁缝，往那里钻。
lines.en: I fix on the nearest reef gap and aim for it.

lines.zh: 它追得慢，我们绕圈就行。
lines.en: It chases slowly; circling will do.

lines.zh: 别单独冲出去，单条最危险。
lines.en: Do not dart out alone; a single fish is the most vulnerable.

lines.zh: 跟着前面的尾鳍，别自己判断。
lines.en: Follow the tail fin ahead and stop second-guessing.

lines.zh: 水花是它转弯的信号。
lines.en: That splash is the signal that it is turning.

lines.zh: 把身体侧薄，能挤过窄缝。
lines.en: Turn my body thin to squeeze through the narrow gap.

lines.zh: 等它累了，我们再散开。
lines.en: When it tires, we scatter again.

lines.zh: 我只有尾巴能甩，甩它一脸水。
lines.en: All I have is my tail, and I splash it.

lines.zh: 撞它一下，趁它愣住就走。
lines.en: Ram it once, and leave while it is startled.

lines.zh: 牙齿很小，咬不住什么。
lines.en: My teeth are tiny and cannot grip anything.

lines.zh: 用身体挡一下，让同伴先走。
lines.en: I block with my body so my schoolmates can flee first.

lines.zh: 鳍拍它的眼睛，只求脱身。
lines.en: Slap its eye with a fin, just to get free.

lines.zh: 这一下没伤到它，倒把自己撞晕。
lines.en: That did not hurt it, but it dazed me.

lines.zh: 几百条一起撞，也会疼的。
lines.en: Hundreds of us ramming together will still hurt.

lines.zh: 咬住它的须，然后松口逃。
lines.en: Bite its barbel, then let go and flee.

lines.zh: 打不过，就钻到礁石下面。
lines.en: If I cannot win, I slip beneath the reef.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽完，赶紧回到群里。
lines.en: After the tail strike, hurry back into the school.

lines.zh: 从卵里出来时，只有一粒米长。
lines.en: When I left the egg, I was only a grain of rice long.

lines.zh: 第一次摆尾，撞到了水草。
lines.en: My first tail beat bumped into a weed.

lines.zh: 浅水暖，先在这里长大。
lines.en: The shallows are warm; I will grow up here first.

lines.zh: 周围全是同伴，数不清。
lines.en: Schoolmates surround me, too many to count.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推进了这片湾。
lines.en: The tide pushed me into this bay.

lines.zh: 身上还是透明的，看得见骨。
lines.en: My body is still clear enough to see my bones.

lines.zh: 第一次见到礁石，绕了三圈。
lines.en: Seeing a reef for the first time, I circled it three times.

lines.zh: 跟着大鱼群的影子走。
lines.en: I follow the shadow of the larger school.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，是我认路的标记。
lines.en: The light on the surface is my landmark.

lines.zh: 今天开始，要自己找吃的了。
lines.en: Starting today, I find my own food.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来了，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The surface is scalding; I dive deeper.

lines.zh: 被抛到空中，落回水里才喘上气。
lines.en: Flung into the air, I only breathed again after hitting water.

lines.zh: 水太多也会闷，鳃里进了沙。
lines.en: Too much water can smother too; sand is in my gills.

lines.zh: 水被震开，耳朵里全是响。
lines.en: The blast shoved the water apart and my head is ringing.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过鳍，游不稳了。
lines.en: Something went through my fin; I cannot swim straight.

lines.zh: 水里起了不该有的味道。
lines.en: A taste appeared in the water that should not be there.

lines.zh: 浮游群没来，肚子贴到脊背。
lines.en: The plankton never came, and my belly is flat.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，整群都僵了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hit the sea and the whole school froze.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我在往下掉。
lines.en: The water is gone, and I am falling.
